remarks: Welcome to Candlelight Terrace! This spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom gem is perfect for those who love comfort and convenience. The master bedroom features a walk-in closet and its own half bathroom, so you'll have your own private retreat. Step outside to your balcony, the ideal spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Inside, you'll enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer/dryer, and cool AC for those warm summer days.  Say goodbye to extra bills - heat, hot water, flood insurance, security cameras, and an on-site super are all included in the common charges. Plus, this pet-friendly community has a plenty of parking right outside the unit and extra storage space for all your gear.  Candlelight Terrace is more than just a place to live - it's a lifestyle. Picture yourself lounging by the in-ground pool, grilling with friends, or strolling through lush gardens along the scenic Rippowam River. With plenty of visitor parking and all of downtown Stamford just minutes away, you're never far from fun, shopping, or dining. Ready to make this charming condo your new home? Let's make it happen!
